title: VanillaFrost
description: This texture pack redesigned combat essentials, featuring smooth textures for armor, weapons, utility items, PvP blocks, and GUI elements.
body:
This PvP texture pack is designed to improve both the look and feel of Minecraft combat while staying true to the vanilla style. Every texture has been carefully redesigned with clean shapes, smooth colors, and better visibility to create a polished experience for every PvP gamemode.

The pack includes custom textures for armor, weapons, tools, utility items, Respawn Anchors, End Crystals, Glowstone, Obsidian, Deepslate, Golden Apples, Ender Pearls, Totems, Shields, Fire, GUI elements, hotbar, hearts, hunger icons, and many other PvP essentials. It also features useful visual improvements such as Low Fire, Small Shield, Block Overlay, and reduced explosion particles to make combat clearer without changing gameplay.

Whether you play Crystal PvP, Sword PvP, PotPvP, UHC, SMP, or other combat-focused gamemodes, this pack is built to provide a clean, consistent, and visually appealing experience while keeping Minecraft's original aesthetic.
